prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, and the services you need. I can help you find the best fit. To get started, here’s a quick framework and next step options.

What matters when choosing an agency
- Primary goals: brand awareness, lead generation, e‑commerce revenue, local foot traffic, app installs, etc.
- Services needed: SEO, PPC, social media, content, email, web design/development, analytics, or full-service strategy.
- Industry experience: B2B, B2C, healthcare, legal, manufacturing, retail, SaaS — industry knowledge shortens ramp time.
- Budget and timeline: monthly ad spend, retainer range, contract length and expected time to results.
- Team size & culture fit: do you need a nimble boutique or an agency with deep cross-channel teams?
- Measurement & reporting: clear KPIs, dashboards, and attribution models.
- Proof: case studies, references, relevant KPIs (CAC, LTV, conversion rates).

How to find and vet local agencies quickly
- Directories & reviews: Clutch.co, UpCity, Google Business listings, LinkedIn company pages.
- Local recognition: St. Louis Business Journal, Ad Age/Adweek mentions, local awards.
- Ask for: 2–3 case studies with measurable results, a sample onboarding/strategy outline, and references from similar clients.
- Interview questions: Who will be our day‑to‑day contacts? How do you measure success? What tech/platforms do you use? Can you show results for businesses like ours?
- Red flags: vague reporting, no references, guaranteed rankings without strategy, unclear pricing.

If you want, I can:
- Produce a curated shortlist (top 4–6 St. Louis agencies) matched to your needs — tell me your industry, monthly budget, and the 2–3 services you need; or
- Give a list of interview questions and a comparison template so you can evaluate proposals.

Which would you prefer?
